description: Use for questions about one plan returned by another tool. Details of one Bloomy eSIM plan by plan_id: data, validity, when validity starts, network (4G/5G) and carriers per country, top-up support, price_jpy, price_usd, price_as_of and the checkout link.

days.description: Trip length in days. For daily plans it sets the number of days and the total price; ignored for fixed-GB plans.

lang.description: Language of country names, reasons and of the checkout page the link opens: en, ja, zh-cn, zh-tw, ko, es or fr. Default en. The language never changes which plan or what price is returned: every plan carries price_jpy and price_usd (both always present) and price_as_of.

plan_id.description: Required. The plan_id from recommend_plan or search_plans, e.g. 14085.

name: get_plan
title: Get plan details
